origins.section: Moving the Closing Delimiter Left Indents Every Line; Moving It Right Changes Nothing

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-middle-line: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-middle-line: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-middle-line: "The compiler counts the leading whitespace of each non-blank line and of the line that holds the closing """, and removes the smallest count from every line." With the delimiter 4 left of the content, every line keeps 4 spaces (closing delimiter 4 to the left output). Here the smallest count is 8, so 16 - 8 = 8.
recorded.prompt:q-query-lines: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-query-lines: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-query-lines: "it counts each whitespace character as one"; query example: tabbed line has 8 leading characters (4 tabs + 4 spaces), others 16, "so 8 go: the space-indented lines keep 8 spaces". The closing line also counts. By the same rule 3 tabs count 3, so 12 - 3 = 9 spaces kept.
recorded.prompt:q-html-list: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-html-list: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-html-list: formatted(body) output: only "····int·total·=·0;" is indented; "for·(int·x..." and "return·total;" start at column 0. "Only the first inserted line got the 4 spaces in front of %s"; a value inserted by formatted "arrives later, and nothing re-indents it".
recorded.prompt:q-footer-file: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-footer-file: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-footer-file: "its javadoc counts the last line 'even if blank'. Text read from a file usually ends with a newline, so its last line is empty, counts 0, and nothing is removed"; sql.stripIndent() output keeps "····SELECT·id,·name".
